subject: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Ramos <kelly@scaleapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Hi Kelly —

Great to connect on the discovery call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule an initial launch session to:

- Walk through prompt examples and expected outputs
- Validate routing/variant selection for your workflows
- Run a small load test to exercise latency profiles

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Mar 2 — 10:00–12:00 (2h)
- Wed, Mar 3 — 13:00–15:00 (2h)
- Fri, Mar 5 — 09:30–11:00 (1.5h)

If none of those work, tell us a couple of times that do. I attached a short questionnaire (initial-questions.docx) to help us tailor the session and an outline of what we'll cover.

Deliverables we'll bring:
- Session agenda + slide deck
- Checklist for environment access and sample prompts
- Small load test plan (non-production safe)

Next steps: pick a time, and we’ll send calendar invites and the prep pack.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com
[attachment: initial-questions.docx (docx)]

From: Kelly Ramos <kelly@scaleapps.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acmehealth.org>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — those windows mostly look good. Quick heads up: our head of infra (Tom) will only be available on Wed afternoon (Mar 3). Could we target Wed, Mar 3 13:00–15:00 PST?

Also would prefer a 90-minute tightly-scoped session if possible — focused on prompt review and routing decisions; if we need load tests we can schedule a separate short run later in the week.

I’ll loop Tom here for the infra checklist items. We also need SOC2 evidence for procurement; if you can surface what you typically share, that would speed approvals.

Best,
Kelly
Product Lead | ScaleApps
kelly@scaleapps.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kelly Ramos <kelly@scaleapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Thanks Kelly — that works for us. Two internal notes:

1) Dev (Dev Patel) will be on leave Mon–Tue, back Wed morning; we can still schedule Wed 13:00 but if we need a brief preflight with Dev to validate routing config, we should do it Wed 09:30–10:00.
2) For SOC2 evidence: I’ll attach our standard procurement packet after I confirm the right audience.

Priyom — I updated the questionnaire with a couple of infra-specific prompts; see the attached (inline edits).

Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: initial-questions.docx (updated)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Ramos <kelly@scaleapps.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@acmehealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Hi all —

Wed, Mar 3 13:00–14:30 PST is locked for a 90-minute session. I trimmed the agenda to match Kelly’s ask (prompt review + routing). We’ll follow up with a separate 45-minute load-test window on Fri if you want to run it with traffic.

Attachments included for the session:
- session-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + timeboxes)
- session-checklist.md (account access, sample prompts, API keys to generate muted tokens)
- slides-runbook-v1.pptx (short slide deck we’ll present)

Please confirm calendar accept; Tom, if you can flag any access gaps in the checklist we’ll remediate before Wed.

Calendar invite sent (expect a follow-up).

Thanks,
Priyom
[attachment: session-agenda-v2.pdf]
[attachment: session-checklist.md]
[attachment: slides-runbook-v1.pptx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kelly Ramos <kelly@scaleapps.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Looks good. Two small asks before Wed:

- Can we add one slide with the load-test acceptance criteria? I attached a CSV with the rough plan (loadtest-plan.csv) — we won't run it during the 90-minute session unless everyone signs off.
- Priyom — please make sure the routing decision table in the checklist includes the fallback model variant for high latency (we saw an edge case last quarter).

I’ll be in the session.

Ben
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[attachment: loadtest-plan.csv]

Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement launch session — scheduling + prep pack

Confirmed from infra side — Wed 13:00–14:30 PST works and I accepted the invite. Two quick asks:

- Please add a short runbook slide showing required IAM roles and example IP ranges for the temporary test endpoint.
- For procurement: SOC2 and retention policy doc would be helpful. If you can drop links to your standard packet in the Drive folder we can include it in our approval flow.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Head of Infrastructure | Acme Health (ScaleApps partner)
